Me? I'm—

Too bad, though. This isn't the spot.
Good thinking, though!

Quickly wiping my mouth, seeing her having so much fun convinced me.
It's close to the academy, where she can grab street snacks and chat with the locals.

So you see, this place where I ran into you
was the correct answer all along!

Now then, what shall we do?
Where are you gonna take me next? Ahaha!

Aw, don't look so down.
I really did have a blast, you know?

I couldn't figure out what she was thinking back then,
but maybe today will be different!

...Hahaha! That sounds fun!
Alright, let's see you guess it!

No, there really was a "correct answer."
You just came up with something so amusing.

These croquettes really are the best.
Sometimes I buy some to take home and eat them with yuzu kosho.

All I wanted was to have a good time,
and you gave me exactly that.

Hey, let's hit the drop tower next!
A free fall from way up high! You don't get a view like that unless you're a hawk!

And once again, I'm reminded of just how much of a free spirit she is—
and how impossible she is to predict.

Great weather today, perfect for going out.
Where are we heading?

An arcade where you can escape ordinary life.
She looks like she's having the time of her life. Which means this is—!

I mean, aren't you curious about the path not taken?
Thanks to that, we got to see all the dolls at the dead ends!

Yeah, it gives it a nice tangy kick... wait, your mouth
is totally covered in croquette crumbs! Ahaha!
That was when I suddenly remembered something that had happened before.
...Well then, allow me to take you to the correct answer.
And then, you showed up.

Alright, another hint!
It's not very far away.

I guess I'll have to get Maruzen to give me driving lessons sometime.
Still, that was a ton of fun!

Ahaha! Honestly, I think so too!
Hey, let's play the destination guessing game again next time!
Right here. This is the correct answer.
All of a sudden, Mr. C.B. came dropping down from a tree...!

We scored some unexpected souvenirs and even got snacks!
Man, it's been forever since I had these sauce-flavored cheap snacks!

Sea glass.
If you look around, you can find quite a bit.

There wasn't any specific place.
I just headed out with no destination in mind.

I guessed wrong... In the end, I spent her entire day off
without taking her where she actually wanted to go.
Oh, are you heading out too?

And so, I ended up playing a guessing game
to figure out Mr. C.B.'s destination...!

It was a day off—having time to kill for once, I was on my way out
toward the station when...

A wave of relief washed over me alongside my exhaustion.
Knowing that I had truly given Mr. C.B. a fun time.

I just climbed up a tree for now, took in the view,
and looked around wondering if there was anywhere fun to go~
...Makes sense now?

Ahaha... If you worry about it like that,
it's gonna make me feel bad, you know?
Hup!

She seemed to be thoroughly enjoying the amusement park.
Seeing how happy she looked made me feel confident, but—

It was really fun. Following along while you tried so hard to figure it out,
and hanging out together wherever we ended up!

Here's a hint! I was feeling bored,
so I just wanted to have some fun~
...Too baaad.
Phew, that was delicious~!

Phew, we sure walked a lot!
That giant maze was pretty darn fun!
Huh...?

During voice training, Mr. C.B. went searching for a place that would raise her spirits.
With every stop we made, I felt like I caught a glimpse into her mindset—

Following after Mr. C.B.,
she led me to the school gate where we first met.

Ahahaha! Uh oh!
I went the wrong way!
